SpacePhone 3.1 BrowserHost third-party notices

The optional browser host includes self-contained Microsoft .NET libraries and the Microsoft WebView2 SDK. These components retain their own copyrights and licences. No endorsement by Microsoft, .NET Foundation, Nexus Mods, or the original game's developers is implied.

Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime is a separate system prerequisite. It is not bundled in this archive. Official installation and distribution documentation:
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/concepts/distribution

BepInEx, Harmony, Il2CppInterop and the original game are external installation/build dependencies. Their DLLs, the game's interop assemblies, sprites, fonts and audio are not included here. An installer should obtain the loader from its official source; any future archive that bundles it must include that actual version's licences and notices.
